text: TLS 1.3's changes were almost entirely removals. Why?
choices: Each removal corresponds to a specific published attack — BEAST, CRIME, POODLE, Lucky13, FREAK, Logjam, DROWN
explanation: It also cut the handshake from two round trips to one, with optional zero round-trip resumption — the recurring theme that round trips are the expensive thing. Knowing the attack history is what makes 'why is this option gone' answerable.
